## Release — backlog-campaign v0.32.0

### ✨ What's new in v0.32.0

#### Owner decisions are parked by default

- Owner questions are now **parked by default** and answered in one round the owner starts (ADR-059, [#1427](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1427), [#1428](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1428)). A new `decisions.mode` setting takes `"park"` or `"ask"`; when it is absent, or holds any value other than `"ask"`, the campaign parks. An away owner (`sleep_mode.enabled: true`) is never asked.
- **`/blackhole decide`** (also "process the decisions" or "answer the decisions") prints a short report, then shows every parked decision as question cards, at most four at a time, most-blocking first. Each answer is recorded as before. It does not change `decisions.mode`, so parking stays on.
- `sleep` now covers only the owner's absence: the keep-awake hold, re-armed wake-ups, a print-only launch gate and the away report. `wake` ends the absence, then runs the decide round. With the owner present, `wake` is the same as `decide`.
- Rounds the owner starts still ask directly: the launch configuration gate on an interactive start, the decide cards, and a follow-up about a message the owner just sent.
- Status surfaces: the Run panel row `Sleep mode` becomes `Decisions` (e.g. `park · 3 waiting — run /blackhole decide · owner away`), the launch summary row `sleep` becomes `decisions`, and the pending panels end with `run /blackhole decide`. When only parked items remain, the loop ends its turn on that line instead of reporting completion.

#### Launch gate

- The launch summary shows every config block ([#1277](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1277), [#1359](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1359)).

#### Merge gate

- An all-skipped check set counts as pending, and required checks are supported ([#1365](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1365)).
- The gate fails closed when no required checks are configured ([#1380](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1380), [#1382](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1382)).
- A newer run of the same PR workflow replaces a cancelled run in the CI verdict ([#1385](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1385)).
- A bare `TRUNCATE` counts as destructive only in SQL statement shape ([#1348](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1348), [#1356](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1356)).

#### Hook guards

- The bash write guard reads `cp`/`install`/`mv` operands past redirects and trailing options ([#1347](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1347), [#1360](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1360)).
- A backslash inside double quotes is kept unless bash drops it ([#1308](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1308), [#1334](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1334)).

#### Usage readings

- File readers accept the desktop `get_usage` payload ([#1361](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1361), [#1373](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1373)), and reject one mixed with top-level windows ([#1384](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1384)).

#### Docs governance and packaging

- Frontmatter schema detection counts matching keys instead of relying on a single discriminator ([#1416](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1416)), and decisions INDEX rows are rendered by the target ADR header's columns ([#1418](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1418)).
- The Claude plugin bundle ships the bash-invoked detector scripts ([#1417](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1417)).

### Migration for existing campaigns

| Campaign state | After upgrading | Action |
|---|---|---|
| No `decisions` block (every campaign today) | Gates park from the next resume; an existing `pending-decisions.json` stays valid | Answer with `/blackhole decide` |
| `sleep_mode: {enabled: false}` (written by every past `wake`) | Read as "the owner came back", **not** as an opt-out, so gates park | To keep asking as each gate fires, set `decisions.mode: "ask"` |
| Owner away (`sleep_mode.enabled: true`, live hold) | `sleep_mode` keeps working: `/blackhole decide` answers the parked decisions while the hold and the print-only launch gate stay | Run `decide` to answer; `/blackhole wake` when back at the machine |
| Published status page | Template moves from `bh-template-version` 8 to 9, so the page reads as behind | Refresh the template on the next launch |
| `--summary --json` consumers | Row key `sleep` becomes `decisions` | Update the reader |

### Upgrade

The plugin cache is version-keyed. Run `/plugin marketplace update blackhole-marketplace`, then reinstall the plugin, and restart Claude Code. A running session keeps its installed version until it restarts.
